design.name: terrain_arc_v2_combined
design.method: Choose among 9 same-side radial endpoints using released heightfield height jumps and 12cm support footprint roughness. Preserve same-start donor pelvis clearance schedule along the designed route.
design.limitation: Pelvis/support-height heuristic, not full-body collision or contact planning. Feasibility is tested in IsaacSim.

target.target: Terrain-designed left/right waypoints; the same-start supported unguided donor supplies recovery clearance and, for pose mode, swing posture.

provenance.schedule_changes: None. Exact lane, costs, physical timing and terminal behavior.
provenance.scope: Single-robot MuJoCo/hardware adaptation; original Isaac batch/DR is not reproduced.
